name: nginx-multisite
description: Configures Nginx for three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, including static site content, TLS certificates, Fail2ban, firewall rules, SSH hardening, sysctl security settings, and Nginx templates.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including service management, Redis authentication, logging, SELinux-compatible PID placement, and cleanup of generated Redis configuration.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs Python and PostgreSQL, deploys the FastAPI tutorial application with a virtual environment and dependencies, provisions its database and environment configuration, and runs it via systemd/Uvicorn on port 8000.
